responseText: A splendid start to being a good neighbor! Just swing by the bulletin board here at the Town Hall and pick out a posted commission. These tasks are the responsibility we've inherited as the keepers of this corner of Verra. It's completing these errands which keeps our civilization thriving and the riffraff out there in the wilderness. Check back with me once you've completed one of the commissions and I'll explain this further.
